text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho has been feeling down
lately, so I
decide to take her to a shrine
to cheer her up a
bit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are we doing here? Praying?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Is that right?
choice_data_list: Maybe a quick prayer will clear your head.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I might as well since we're
here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho prays that she'll feel better
soon.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Um... Please help me turn things
around...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I want to become a great witch, just like
Granny!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And also, I wanna make a spell that lets
me win
races. Oh, and a spell to make
Trainer a more
obedient familiar...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And I want that big stuffed animal I saw
at the
mall the other day too! And I
wanna eat lots of
sugar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And then... And then...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You've got some nerve, interrupting
your master
while she's praying.
choice_data_list: Aren't you wishing for a bit too much...?
Aren't you wishing for a bit too much...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eh, oh well. I asked for everything I
want! Now I'm
gonna be an even bigger
genius magical girl!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing, Familiar? Let's go
already!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look over there! Is that a cotton
candy
stand?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There are food stalls out even though
there's no
event on? That's so lucky!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't just stand there spacing out!
Go get
some cotton candy for me! Your
treat, obviously!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I got to eat something sweet right
away!
My prayers have been
answered! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If all my wishes keep coming true like
this, I'll be a
great witch in no time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hmmm! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a stretch to say that her
prayers for
getting something sweet
came true when she
basically forced it,
but it looks like she's feeling
better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, what the heck?! Is that crow poop?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Crows are supposed to be witches'
minions! What
are you thinking, doing
something so rude to a
genius magical
girl?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! Hurry up and get me a wet
handkerchief!
And go buy me a change
of clothes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh, this is the worst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This sudden stroke of bad luck has put
an even
bigger damper on Sweep
Tosho's mood.
